source_en: Have you noticed the shadow your booth makes? Nini Bitsadze. I paint.
I'm painting the light since the dust. The difference is extraordinary.
Like the world's lit from below. Everything has an amber cast.
The opposite. Everything's strange and honest. It won't last.
The [[infected:charcoal on my hands]] never comes off. Tamar checks on me mornings.
My caretaker. I have a condition. It's managed.
Good. The last officer asked every time. I started counting.
You have a good face for charcoal. I've been sketching it since you sat down.
